question.text: Kaveri Macro Fund (Cat III, irrevocable determinate trust) realised INR 40 lakh STCG from STT-paid listed equity shares held 9 months. Using Section 111A post-Budget 2024 rate (ignore surcharge/cess), the pure STCG tax at fund level is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook (p. 365), STCG on STT-paid listed equity is taxed at 20% under Section 111A. Tax = 40,00,000 x 20% = INR 8,00,000 (before surcharge and cess). Page 371 also confirms the post-surcharge effective rate stack. The Trap: INR 6,00,000 corresponds to a 15% rate, INR 4,00,000 to 10%, and INR 12,00,000 to 30%. Candidates who do not apply the current workbook rate of 20% pick a stale figure. Note: Only the current workbook-cited 20% rate and its arithmetic are used here.
